concerns.text: FR-001 mandates 'pixel-wise salience maps ... using the DeepGaze II model in CPU-only mode', but the plan (T003) computes salience with OpenCV spectral residual + center-surround fallback. The deviation is justified (T003 unverifiable) and logged in Complexity Tracking, but the spec FR text is unchanged, so the plan does not cover FR-001 as written. Update spec FR-001 (and US-1/Assumptions referencing DeepGaze II) to name the CPU spectral-residual method so plan and spec agree.

FR-008 mandates 'an ensemble of YOLOv8 (for faces) and Detectron2 (for weapons)'; the plan drops Detectron2 and uses YOLOv8 for both classes (T004, Complexity Tracking). The plan element has no matching FR as specified. Amend FR-008 (and the Assumption about the ensemble) to reflect single-detector YOLOv8 segmentation.
